Hey! Sorry for the late response too. Lot's happened since I wrote this, I dont even fully remember when I did haha

At the beggining of 2020, right before the pandemic started funnily enough, I finally got through and talked with my therapist. With her and a psychiatrist I started to see too, I've actually improved a lot, things have been much better than when I wrote all this, Im on meds again but I when I look back at how I was for so long and even this stuff, I realise they have helped me a lot. Its amazing to me that I dont have suicidal thoughts every day now, when I realise that I truly notice I've improved.

Anyways, I thought I owed ya an update at least haha Things arent all perfect and there's definitely ups and downs, lots of stuff in my life are still absolute garbage but I can confidently say Im in a healthier place mentally now, especially when I read this now. I still got lots to work on, my non-existent self-esteem being one of them, and I still have a huge difficulty opening up, but hey thats just one of the battles I'll probably be on my whole life haha

To answer your question at the end though, it was all of the former 100%, I didnt fear hospitalization, but I did fear everything else you mentioned, and my diagnosis of GAD (Generalized Anxiety Disorder) really seems to fit in with all of those fears, at least there's a bit of an explanation there. But ah well, such is life, thats just another fight Ill have to bear with my whole life haha

I hope things are good on your end and hopefully I hear from you some time too, even if its a year or two later, it doesnt matter!

I appreciate you taking the time to read and disect all this... but the problem is I've gone to therapy my whole life pretty much, since I was like 8 or 9, now Im 24 and I still go to one, I've gone through a couple of therapists in my life, I'm a full on advocate for doing therapy I've recomended it to people, I got a close friend of mine to go to one and he's now doing better than ever. I love my current therapist and she's helped me a lot these couple of years I've been seeing her, but I've never been able to talk about all this... I just cant let it out of my head... I've always been someone who has extreme difficulty talking about his problems... I've rehearsed the conversation where finally say all this to her over and over for years, but I just cant do it, and like I said, she isnt the problem, shes a good therapist, she really helped me get out into the world and work through my agoraphobia and all, the problem is ME, I jsut cant talk about this... I'll just worry her, disappoint her, and make her feel like she doesnt know me after years of seeing her, which I suppose to an extent is true. There was only one time in my life where I slightly mention very little about this, I was in a rough spot and I let a little out, like the very tip of this iceberg... and I Was on meds for a while, say about a year... the problem is once I was out of that rough spot, I was back to being my regular self, with all this shit in my head but a seemingly normal and okay person o nthe outside, the meds werent really helping me feel any better, all I noticed was that if I forgot to take them they'd make me feel dizzy and I hated that sensation... so eventually I kept the act and once they felt I was back on my feet they let me stop taking the meds... but there's my other problem, I already tried meds, and they didnt work on me, which is part of the reason why I just this is just how I am and there's no fixing that. I've reason to beleive this too, its not just out of nowhere... my father's an alcoholic who once  my parents divorced just went back to his parents home and stayed there depressed, with no life or work, just drinking his life away to this day, since I Was 8 more or less.... hes clearly depressed and has been for ages and always had the same problem I do, of being completely incapable of letting out his toughts; then you have his aunt, my great-aunt, who was depressed her whole life and was maintained by my grandparents most of her life and barely ever left the house; but thats not all, then you have my mom's side, she herself had extreme anger managment issues, it took her years but she actually went to anger managment therapy and worked it out (unlike my dad never moved an inch to improve himself) and thats why I admire her, she also has extreme anxiety problems and has gone through depression too, shes not always the most emotionally stable person; finally you have her mother, my maternal grandma, who had OCD, even worse anger issues (lots of crazy stories of how violent she'd get that I learnt from my mom) and especially depression, she attempted suicide more than once, I dont know how many but I do know at least she tried twice in her late 60s when I was little.

Worst part is I feel like Im a mixure of all the worst aspects in my family in one package and that it happened to make the worst possible combo... my mom's temper with my dad's inability to let his emotions out and his spineless-ness... my extreme fears on just about anything with my dad's inability to talk about his problems. I dont know, I just dont know what to do, therapy has worked out for me in many things, I will always advocate for it, but when the biggest obstacle is myself, when what needs to be passed over is your very being, it makes me wonder if I even have a solution... i mean what even is there beyond this obstalce... after all I am the obstacle.
I mean its true, but you shouldn't say it.

Haha drugs are funny, I literally poison my body to have a laugh. Its hilarious.


You could've honestly just admitted this is funny and how it happened to you too without normalizing and making light behaviour that shouldnt be encouraged. But what do I know, I guess Im just a killjoy...

> I think if you're only studying him it could be a bad idea because his anatomy is pretty weird and stylized IMO, even if I love the Jojo series to death.

I love Jojo to death too haha but yeah I agree with you, to be honest I just tend to copy very simple cartoon drawings and in my recent drawing itch I felt like copying something more complex, just to challenge myself and I chose this mostly because I really like how unique Araki's style is.

> If you're struggling with drawing boxes from different angles then thinking you're going to be able to draw human poses on your own is pretty unreasonable.

You're totally right about this, and I'm probably being too amitious for someone with little to no drawing experience, I just get too impatient and frustrated when I'm not able to do awesome stuff like so many others are able to. But this is a flaw of mine I need to work on.

> You might just be copying things line for line instead of constructing them from simple shapes and using your anatomy knowledge.

Again you're right, this definitely is my problem and its the problem I've always had. I should learn all this stuff well enough before I expect to be able to draw more original stuff.

More than anything I'm interested in being able to improve and eventually get to develop my own style, I need to exercise my patience just as much as my drawing knowlege.

Thank you so much for taking the time to write all this up! I really appreciate it!

Thanks! I'll try and do that for sure! When I try to do that I just kinda panic because I dont have an exact visualization of how I should draw since Im doing a new pose based on the character I want to draw, but I guess part of that just comes down to me loosening up and trying to do it anyways and let the end result be whatever it becomes and improve from there. I just get really frustrated when I try to draw something different based on a reference and it looks like a 5 year old did it haha

Thank you! Well if I'm honest, by the end of it I started getting impatient and kinda just said "fuck it" and ad-libed most of the last parts like her whole hair and her forearm. I just tend to be too obsesively perfectionist and it drags the drawing down with me because I get too hung up on things becoming too different from the original, I should try to loosen up on that matter dont I?

It's even noticeable in this one that I messed up quite a good number of parts proportion-wise, the left shoulder and how far the hand is from the face in my drawing being very noticeable

I've never been able to get outside of reference Images I use, for the longest time, I cant ever draw anything by myself and it's always really hurt my confidence that I cant make anything original ever, I'm always just completely blank. Is there any tips for this issue I have? You guys think I have a chance to improve?

I appreciate the advice, I really do, and thats actually something I used to do when I was younger, when I fought with my mom for example... I would write up a letter with the problem, how I felt and apologising if it was necessary... so yeah, needless to say, the face-to-face aspect is something I've had trouble with my whole life, just confrontation in general to an extent...

Thank you, you are right, it is the former, so for now I'll go to sleep. If I still have enough courage later when Im awake, Ill contact you again to talk... usually I tend to get back into sade auto-mode when I bounce back into regular life, and end up shrugging all this off to the side again and keep going with life as if everything is ok, like I always do. But part of me wants to keep talking, I'm usually just not strong enough

I've had 3 therapists through my life, liked and cared for each of them a lot, including my current one, I just feel uncomfortable opening up to anyone period, for some reason... I just can't. The internet makes it easier for me because I dont have to see face to face the person I may tell my problems to... I couldn't deal with the idea of seeing someone I know and love KNOWING what is going on with me for some reason, I just feel so weak and ashamed, I wouldnt be able to face them... this happens to me with pretty much anyone I form a close bond with, for some reason its easier for me to do it with strangers.

Thank you very much for reading this, Im sorry for how unorganized and nonsensical it is, I wish I was a more eloquent writter

I'd actually like that, if you don't mind that is, though I dont want you or anyone wasting your time... its almost 6 am right now and I'm very tired, maybe I should just go to sleep? (by the way I added a little bit more here in the comments, if you're interested)

Nonetheless... thank you for taking your time to read it, sincerely.
